title: 全球医疗通胀：数倍于普通通胀，大湾区能否成解药？
speaker: Jason Salar

segments.en: Yeah, well, first of all, it is great to be back. I lived and worked in Hong Kong for 15 plus years, so always appreciate the opportunities to come back.
segments.zh: 首先，很高兴回来。我在香港生活和工作了超过15年，所以一直很珍惜回来的机会。

segments.en: And spending some time with the team, I'm here for just over two and a half days, understanding what the growth plans are for the future.
segments.zh: 这次回来待两天半左右，和团队一起探讨未来的增长计划。

segments.en: Obviously, Asia, we see a lot of opportunities here, and really it was a great opportunity to meet some of our clients, some of the partners that we work with, but most importantly, spend time with the team.
segments.zh: 显然，我们在亚洲看到了很多机会。这次也有机会会见一些客户和合作伙伴，但最重要的是和团队在一起。

segments.en: Tell us about Hong Kong specifically. I think you kind of built this business from the ground up way back when. How do you think the landscape has changed, the talent here and everything?
segments.zh: 具体谈谈香港吧。你当年是从零开始建立这项业务的。你觉得这里的格局和人才等方面发生了哪些变化？

segments.en: We've been operating in Hong Kong for 90 plus years, so yes, we have a long history here. But I think particularly as one of the positives that actually came out of COVID was the growing awareness with everybody about the importance of looking after their health.
segments.zh: 我们在香港运营超过90年，历史悠久。但我觉得疫情带来的一个积极影响是，大家越来越意识到健康的重要性。

segments.en: And as a global health services company, I mean, that's great, some great opportunities for us. More and more, we're now seeing the greater bay opportunity come into play.
segments.zh: 作为一家全球健康服务公司，这为我们带来了巨大机遇。我们越来越看到大湾区机遇正在显现。

segments.en: But again, top of everybody's mind, and you've touched on it earlier, is definitely rising health care costs. What do you think is driving that?
segments.zh: 但正如你之前提到的，大家最关心的问题无疑是医疗成本上升。您认为是什么推动了这一趋势？

segments.en: Multiple factors. I mean, everybody used to think of health care inflation as a US problem. It's now a global problem.
segments.zh: 多重因素。过去人们认为医疗通胀是美国的问题，现在已成为全球性问题。

segments.en: In all markets we operate in, health care inflation is at a multiple of normal of inflation.
segments.zh: 在我们运营的所有市场中，医疗通胀率都是普通通胀率的数倍。

segments.en: That's driven by basically new pharmacy drugs with higher costs coming on. People more concerned about the health, so they want to go to the doctor more frequently.
segments.zh: 这主要是由成本更高的新药上市推动的。人们更加关注健康，因此更频繁地就医。

segments.en: Various factors, and then you've got aging population and things like that as well. All of that is driving up, so the health care costs and affordability being a concern on top of everybody's mind.
segments.zh: 还有人口老龄化等因素。这些都推高了医疗成本，可负担性成为大家最关心的问题。
